limits: WP00 remains DRAFT/BLOCKED: 39 PASS, 26 PARTIAL, 19 BLOCKED, 1 NOT_PROVEN across 85 unchanged canonical criteria.
C07 six routine exports, C08 provider behavior and C15 bundle remain positive failing consumer acceptance gates. No expected-failure or skip masks them.
Sucafina typecheck has 144 inherited diagnostics in 50 files, including the missing routine factory import from host-context.ts; zero new own WP00 test diagnostics after W8.
Candidate business UI failed before authentication with C15. All 1260 planned repetitions are cancelled, not zero-latency successes; no median, p95, 200ms or regression acceptance.

Historical baseline is not timed. Its own CLI lacks the installation loader; the historical external host is unpinned. Mixed host/module composition requires explicit dual provenance and comparable outcomes. See historical-baseline-compatibility.md.
The scanner-absent and controlled real invocation failure paths pass safely. Bun is not a scanner; installed scanner clean/hit, C17 and native host acceptance remain unproven/HOLD.
No Session/provider/model/case/SkillLoadReceipt/private-MCP/native consumer chain is qualified. Fixture identity/receipts and agent collaboration do not establish GNATIVE.
Expanded 25-project DOCX/PPTX corpus proof is not the full J05 native scenario or authenticated browser journey.
Contracts and consumer runs belong to W8. W9/W10 alter only browser.ts and zoom-capability.spec.ts; remote comparisons prove all selected Bun and product implementation blobs unchanged.
All product execution was hosted in GitHub Actions; local actions only read/edit/hash source, validate request metadata and inspect downloaded evidence. Remote operations used GitHub MCP.
